meta.title: Gloaming · A quiet place for real reading
meta.description: Read source texts you chose. When stuck, get help beside the page—then keep reading.

opening.titleLine1: Real source texts are worth reading,
opening.body1: When you hit a hard passage, you leave the page to look something up, open a translator, or ask a chatbot. By the time you return, the reading is broken.
opening.body2: Gloaming is a quiet reading environment: the activity stays reading. Help appears beside the text only when you’re stuck—then you continue. English ebooks are the focus today.

problem.title: The hard part isn’t finding content. It’s stopping mid-read.
problem.lead: It often isn’t that a word is too hard—it’s that every tool pulls you out of the page you wanted to stay in.

1.title: One lookup, and you’ve left the page
1.body: Switch apps, copy-paste, come back—and the context you just built is gone.

2.title: Ask for help, and it turns into class, drills, or chat
2.body: Quizzes, review curves, long dialogues. You only wanted to keep reading.

3.title: Next time, you can’t find where you stopped
3.body: Books scatter, progress fades, and it’s easier to give up than to resume.

solution.title: How we solve it
solution.lead: Keep the energy on reading itself—from choosing a text, through hard lines, to picking up again.

beatA.label: Beat A
beatA.title: Bring content in first
beatA.body: Upload EPUBs and other files into your Library, or open works you already added. We don't invent "learning articles" as the main content.

points.1: Your uploads stay in a private library shelf
points.2: Continue where you left off from one home surface

beatB.label: Beat B
beatB.title: When stuck, understand beside the text—then continue
beatB.body: Select a passage to look up, translate, or explain in context. Listen when you want, or open a parallel view. The default stays the source text; turn help off and the text still reads.

points.1: Help stays beside the page—no app switching
points.3: Open bilingual view when useful, hide it anytime

beatC.label: Beat C
beatC.title: Come home to what you left unfinished
beatC.body: Library isn’t a study dashboard. Open it and continue reading—uploads and saved titles live together.

points.1: Continue Reading returns you to where you stopped
points.2: No streak badges, no vocab homework alerts

boundaries.title: What we deliberately don’t do
boundaries.lead: Protecting attention matters more than packing features.

1.title: No course trees or homework
1.body: You don’t level up through drills. Real source text is the material.

2.title: No shame streaks
2.body: Reading is interest, not a number holding you hostage.

3.title: Vocab collecting isn’t the main job
3.body: The job is finishing the page—not building a word deck.

4.title: Chat is not the home screen
4.body: Home is the shelf and the text. Help appears only when asked.

invite.titleLine1: Find a source text you want,
invite.body: When stuck, understand beside the page—then continue. Not a class. Not a chat.
invite.footnote: Open and read · Import your own files · Keep reading first
